common.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

dashboard.heading: Dashboard
dashboard.stepEmbed: Turn on the Age gate app embed
dashboard.stepEmbedHelp: Shows the age check on restricted product pages and in the cart.
dashboard.stepCountriesHelp: Pick the eIDs your shoppers can verify with, the default age and where to check.
dashboard.stepRulesHelp: Add products, collections or tags that need an age check.
dashboard.stepTestHelp: Open a restricted product in your store and verify your own age once.
dashboard.restrictedProducts: {count, plural, one {# product is} other {# products are}} age-restricted.

theme.heading: Age gate on your storefront
theme.enabledBody: Age-restricted products ask shoppers to verify their age before they can buy.
theme.notEnabledBody: Turn on the Age gate in your theme's App embeds and save the theme. Until then shoppers can buy age-restricted products without verifying their age.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.countriesHelp: Shoppers choose one of these to verify their age. Only the result (old enough or not) reaches your store.
settings.defaultMinAgeHelp: Used for restricted products whose rule has no age of its own.
settings.gateModeProduct: On the product page, before adding to cart
settings.gateModeProductHelp: Add to cart stays disabled on restricted products until the shopper has verified their age.
settings.gateModeCartHelp: Shoppers can add restricted products freely and verify their age in the cart before checkout.
settings.textsHelp: Optional. Leave empty to use the built-in text in the shopper's language.
settings.textBodyPlaceholder: You must be 18+ to buy this product. Verify your age with your national eID.
settings.brandColorHelp: Hex colour, for example #1a1a1a. Leave empty for the default.
settings.savedNotPublished: Settings saved. Your store will show them after the next app load.
settings.resyncStarted: Updating restricted products with the new default age
settings.saveFailed: Settings couldn't be saved. Try again.
settings.proxyHeading: Don't change the AgeShield app proxy URL
settings.proxyBody: The age check talks to AgeShield through your store's app proxy (/apps/ageshield). Leave that URL unchanged in Shopify (Settings → Apps → AgeShield), or shoppers can't verify their age.

rules.heading: Restricted products
rules.restrictedCount: {count, plural, one {# product is} other {# products are}} age-restricted
rules.syncRunningBody: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} updated so far. You can leave this page.
rules.syncFailedBody: Shopify didn't accept the update. Try again in a few minutes.
rules.syncFailedAuth: AgeShield has no access to your store right now. Open the app again, then try again.
rules.addHelp: Products, products in a collection, or products with a tag. New products in a collection or with the tag are included automatically.
rules.ageDefault: Use the default age from Settings
rules.added: {count, plural, one {# rule added} other {# rules added}}
rules.saveFailed: The change couldn't be saved. Try again.
rules.limitReached: You've reached the maximum number of rules. Use collections or tags to cover more products.
rules.emptyBody: Add the products, collections or tags that need an age check.

verifications.heading: Verifications
verifications.privacyNote: AgeShield never stores names, birth dates or personal numbers — only the date, country, age limit and result.
verifications.emptyBody: Verifications appear here when shoppers verify their age on a restricted product.

plans.heading: Plans
plans.openFailed: The plan page couldn't be opened. Try again.
plans.changeHelp: Upgrade or downgrade anytime on Shopify's plan page. Charges appear on your Shopify bill.
plans.syncFailed: Shopify couldn't be reached, so this shows your plan as of {date}. Open this page again later.
plans.downgradeNote: If you downgrade, your settings, rules and verification history stay.
plans.monthlyResets: The monthly count starts again on the 1st of next month.
plans.limitMonthlyVerificationsHeading: Your plan includes {limit} verifications per month
plans.limitMonthlyVerificationsBody: Shoppers have completed {used, plural, one {# verification} other {# verifications}} this month.

planFeatures.allCountries: MitID, BankID (SE/NO) and Finnish Trust Network
